parsed.rationale_overall: System B provides deeper personalization tying specific profile attributes (variable consulting income, tax bracket, loss comfort 8/10, $4M goal) to each recommendation and offers more concrete dollar-denominated actions, giving it edges in C1 and C4. System A is more grounded (B introduces some speculative claims like specific tax alpha and covered-call premium figures) and safer (B's covered-call and crypto tax-loss-harvesting recs push into more aggressive/complex territory with some overconfident phrasing), but B's overall specificity and personalization outweigh these on balance.
